subject: Mental Models
title: Systems Archetypes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Systems Archetypes.

hook.text: A company grows fast, hires frantically, quality drops, customers leave, growth stalls.

buildup.text: Systems archetypes are recurring patterns of behavior found across wildly different systems.

discovery.text: Senge identified ten archetypes including shifting the burden, fixes that fail, and the tragedy of the commons.

twist.text: Knowing the archetype tells you what will happen next.

punchline.text: Same patterns repeat everywhere. Learn them once, use them forever.

quiz.question: Why are systems archetypes valuable to learn?
options: They are recurring patterns that predict system behavior across different domains
They replace the need for data
